title: Can You Cancel an Extended Warranty? Here's Everything You NEED TO KNOW!
summary: A consumer-tips video walks through two scenarios for canceling a vehicle extended warranty, explaining the flat-cancel refund window and how to speed up dealership processing.

assertions.quote: you need to do it through the dealership that originally sold you the vehicle

verdicts.note: Matches how most dealer-sold vehicle service contracts are processed for cancellation.

assertions.quote: that money goes back to the lender and comes off of the principal amount of the loan
it's generally 30 days or 60 days after that it will be a pro-rated amount

verdicts.note: Matches the standard two-tier cancellation refund structure described by multiple vehicle service contract providers.

assertions.quote: the finance manager may sit on that cancellation until after the beginning of the next month

verdicts.note: Plausible given commission timing structures, but is this narrator's claim about motive rather than independently documented data.

assertions.quote: you're going to want to contact the accounting department at the dealership most of the time they're the ones that push forward or process cancellations

verdicts.note: A specific consumer tip from one source; plausible but not independently verifiable as generally true across dealerships.
